journal_lines: §oChased prey into timber so dense the hunter called back for the axe. The axe opened the route.
§aWoodcutter felled a tree across the quarry's escape path. §lHunter§a finished what the tree started.
Prey flushed out of the brush by the axe work — woodcutter did not intend it, hunter did not complain.
§aForest worked for both today. §lTimber§a came down, quarry came down, same clearing, same hour.
Hunter read the game trail. Woodcutter read the canopy. Between them the chase never had a good exit.
§aBrush too thick to run through without clearing. The clearing made the chase. The chase made the catch.
§oThe whole forest smelled like running and cut pine at once. Good combination. Both bags filled.
§aQuarry went into the timber expecting cover. §lWoodcutter§a removed the cover. Hunter followed the quarry.
